name: Home Depot RDC - Locust Grove GA

fieldNotes.resolution: Roster geocode (33.216581,-83.930773) was wrong by ~25 km — landed in rural farmland SE of Locust Grove. Correct facility resolved via web research to 3150 Hwy 42 S, Locust Grove (HD DC #5250 / RDC 5250), a 657,518 sq ft RDC on ~130 acres off I-75, bought by Monmouth REIT for $96.7M in 2020. Building positively located at ~33.363,-84.119.
fieldNotes.imagery: Satellite imagery of this site is significantly cloud-affected at z16-z19 — the central building roof and the truck entrance are partially obscured. Building outline, the SE-face dock bank, and trailer rows are still readable; the gate structure itself could not be directly imaged.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Not directly imaged due to cloud cover; HD's own security-guard role descriptions for its RDC network describe staffed truck check-in (in-gate/out-gate). Inferred TRUE as standard for an HD RDC of this scale; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred TRUE — HD RDC security guards staff truck check-in per HD job descriptions; booth not directly imaged. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Continuous dock doors visible on the long SE face plus a separate dock bank on the SW face — inbound/outbound likely run from separate banks (typical RDC cross-dock).
fieldNotes.dropArea: A trailer parking area is visible NE of the building; count obscured by cloud — estimated 10-25 band, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: 130-acre site with deep ring-road approach gives ample queue depth before docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very large site (land-to-building ratio ~9x) with abundant unused paved/undeveloped width near the entrance — room for an express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Locust Grove (Henry County), small town 36 mi south of Atlanta — industrial pocket surrounded by woodland and farmland. Classed Rural per rubric (small-town industrial -> Rural).
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the SW edge between Hwy 42 and the property, but no spur is visible entering the DC — set false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 130 acres per the Monmouth REIT acquisition disclosure (authoritative).

citations.claim: Home Depot opened a new distribution center in Locust Grove GA, ~700 jobs.
